subject: psychology

moments.title: Counselling and Psychotherapy
moments.body: Rogers proposes 'non-directive' therapy in which the therapist provides empathic understanding rather than interpretation.
moments.takeaway: Therapy can be reframed as client-led.

moments.title: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions
moments.body: Rogers specifies empathy, congruence and unconditional positive regard as necessary and sufficient for therapeutic change.
moments.takeaway: A bold empirical claim invited half a century of testing.

moments.title: A Way of Being
moments.body: Rogers extends person-centred principles to education, encounter groups and conflict resolution.
moments.takeaway: Therapeutic concepts can travel beyond clinical settings.

now.title: Common factors in therapy
now.body: Meta-analyses (Wampold) suggest much therapeutic outcome is explained by common factors close to Rogers's conditions.
now.open_questions: How should training balance technique-specific and common factors?

reflection: Rogers's humanistic psychology was once mainstream; CBT's rise has pushed it to the margins of evidence-based practice.
